featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The NHD-0401-MV is a powerful multiview switcher that can be used as a standalone solution or with a NetworkHD 400 or 500 series system. The switcher comes pre-loaded with six different multiview layouts offering unique viewing experiences. 4K60 HDMI 2.0 inputs allow the switcher to support all the latest 4K HDR content with zero compression. Direct integration with the NHD-CTL-PRO provides a seamless solution for pairing this switcher with NetworkHD encoders & decoders to add multiview capability to an AV over IP project.

Each input supports the latest HDMI 2.0 content, including 4K60 4:4:4 and high dynamic range such as HDR10, HLG and Dolby Vision. A built-in HDMI downscaler will automatically adjust the resolution to match the maximum capability of the connected display.

The NHD-0401-MV is specifically designed to fit perfectly inside the NHD-000-RACK4, making it easy to be part of a NetworkHD system. Slot the switcher next other encoders and decoders for a tidy and convenient installation.
